title: Base64 Converter
description: Encode and decode Base64 in the browser, with UTF-8 support, Base64URL, and privacy notices.
metaDescription: Encode and decode Base64 in the browser, with UTF-8 support, Base64URL, and strict malformed input validation.

form.title: Convert Base64
form.description: Paste text or Base64 to encode, decode, and copy the result without uploading.

input.title: Input
input.label: Text or Base64
input.privacy: Conversion happens in your browser. This tool does not send the content to the server.

options.title: Settings
options.description: Choose the operation, alphabet, and how to handle padding or copied line breaks.

alphabets.label: Alphabet
alphabets.description: Base64URL replaces + and / with - and _ for safer use in URLs.

padding.label: Keep = padding when encoding
padding.description: Applies to encoded output. Some systems require the trailing = sign.

whitespace.label: Ignore whitespace when decoding
whitespace.description: Removes spaces, tabs, and line breaks before validating Base64.

share.title: Share
share.description: By default, the link stores only operation, alphabet, and options.
share.includeContent: Include input in the shared link
share.safe: The current link does not include pasted text.
share.publicWarning: Links with content expose the input to anyone who receives the URL.
share.tooLong: The input is too large for a safe link. The link will include only settings and the content option.

result.title: Result
result.description: Decoding requires valid Base64 and valid UTF-8 bytes for text.
result.emptyDescription: Paste text to encode or Base64 to decode.
result.validDecodeDescription: {alphabet} input decoded to text with {bytes} UTF-8 bytes.
result.invalidBase64Description: Fix characters, alphabet, padding, or length and try again.
result.invalidUtf8Description: The Base64 is syntactically valid, but the bytes do not form valid UTF-8 text.
result.tooLargeDescription: The automatic limit is {limit} characters to avoid browser freezes.

errors.invalidCharacter: The input contains characters outside the selected alphabet.
errors.mixedAlphabet: The input mixes standard Base64 and Base64URL symbols.
errors.invalidPadding: The = padding appears in an invalid position or count.
errors.invalidLength: The normalized length is not valid for Base64.
errors.invalidUtf8: The decoded bytes are not valid UTF-8 text.
errors.inputTooLarge: The input exceeds this tool's size limit.

seoDetails.title: How conversion works
seoDetails.utf8Description: When encoding, text becomes UTF-8 bytes before Base64 is applied. Accents, symbols, and emoji work without direct btoa use.
seoDetails.urlDescription: Base64URL uses - and _ instead of + and /, a common format for URLs, tokens, and parameters.
seoDetails.securityDescription: Base64 is reversible. Do not use it as protection for passwords, tokens, or private data.

encryption.question: Is Base64 encryption?
encryption.answer: No. Base64 is only reversible encoding. Anyone with the encoded text can decode the content.

privacy.question: Is the text sent to the server?
privacy.answer: No. Conversion happens in the browser. Content only enters the link when you enable the include input option.

difference.question: What is the difference between Base64 and Base64URL?
difference.answer: Base64URL replaces the + and / symbols with - and _, which avoids problems in URLs and some tokens.

invalidUtf8.question: Why can valid Base64 fail to become text?
invalidUtf8.answer: Because Base64 can represent binary bytes. This version decodes only bytes that form valid UTF-8 text.

padding.question: Do I need to keep = padding?
padding.answer: It depends on the system. Traditional Base64 often uses padding, while URL-safe strings often omit the = sign.

sharing.question: Can I share already filled input?
sharing.answer: Yes, but only after enabling the option to include input in the link. Do not use that with secrets, tokens, credentials, or personal data.

seo.about: The converter transforms text into Base64 or Base64URL and decodes Base64 back to UTF-8 text. It validates characters, padding, length, and UTF-8 bytes before showing output.
seo.howToUse: Paste content, choose encode or decode, select Base64 or Base64URL, and copy the output. Shared links preserve only settings by default; include content in the link only when it can be public to whoever receives the URL.
